title: Evaluator Version V1
description: An immutable, content-addressable record of one version of an evaluator's judge configuration. Introduced in R3 alongside dataset_version_schema.json so a run's evaluator identity can be pinned to the exact judge configuration used, independent of the mutable evaluator_config resource (evaluator_config_schema.json). This is a new, additive contract: no existing schema references it yet, so there is no compatibility surface to preserve beyond the rules stated on `judge_config_digest` below. Nothing in the certification family's process-record V1 digest-domain registry (traigent_schema/schemas/certification/process_record_v1_schema.json) changes as a result of this file.

EvaluatorJudgeConfigDigestDomainV1.description: Fixed domain-separation tag for the evaluator judge-config digest. The digest construction is sha256 over UTF8(domain) || 0x00 || jcs_v1(judge_config) -- the same role-digest idiom the certification family uses (see traigent_schema.certification.evaluator_quality_verifier._role_digest and traigent_schema.fp2 for the jcs_v1 canonicalization). Because jcs_v1 canonicalizes object keys by UTF-16 code-unit order before hashing, the digest is independent of the key order in the judge_config object supplied by the caller.

EvaluatorVersionV1.description: An immutable evaluator version resource, keyed by `id`, referencing the evaluator it versions via `evaluator_id` (matches the `evaluator_id` string used by observability/evaluator_run_schema.json) with a monotonically increasing `version` counter per evaluator_id.

id.description: Unique identifier for this evaluator version.

evaluator_id.description: Reference to the evaluator this is a version of.

version.description: Monotonic version number for this evaluator_id, starting at 1.

judge_config_digest.description: sha256:<hex> over UTF8('traigent.evaluator.judge_config.v1') || 0x00 || jcs_v1(judge_config), where judge_config is the evaluator's canonical judge configuration object (e.g. the evaluator_config_schema.json fields governing how the judge scores an output -- model, instructions, context_type/context_source, and any judge-specific parameters). Key order in judge_config is irrelevant: jcs_v1 canonicalization sorts object keys before hashing. This field is OPTIONAL and ADDITIVE: it is null for every evaluator version created before this contract existed, and old readers that do not know this field ignore it entirely. New readers MUST treat null as "no content identity available" -- never as empty configuration or as equal to any other null. Computed offline by traigent_schema.content_identity.compute_judge_config_digest; this schema does not require callers to populate it.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this evaluator version was created.
